max_tire.note: IH8MUD: fits with zero rubbing. 285/70R18 rubs a bit but is manageable; 275/70s are the 'tried and true' size.
A common size on lifted trucks in the forum's 35-inch roll call, usually with aftermarket upper control arms and wheels.

Owners report front mud flaps removed, a Slee KDSS relocation, light fender-liner trimming and aftermarket wheels. Without those, 35s rub on the stock upper control arms and KDSS arms. One set measured just over 34 inches mounted.

items.title: Seat-belt tension sensor harness can disable passenger airbags
items.summary: The harness can break and switch off the front passenger, knee and seat-mounted side airbags.

items.title: Incorrect driver or passenger airbag fitted
items.summary: Some trucks may have the wrong airbag assembly installed (FMVSS 208); dealers replace it.

items.title: Accelerator pedal floor-mat entrapment
items.summary: An unsecured or incompatible floor mat can trap the pedal wide open; dealers modify or replace the pedal and replace wrong mats.

items.title: TPMS non-compliance
items.summary: Tire-pressure monitoring system failed FMVSS 138 requirements.

items.title: Denso low-pressure fuel pump
items.summary: The Denso low-pressure fuel pump can fail and stall the engine while driving. 20V012000 was the original campaign and 20V682000 expanded it; NHTSA's lookup also lists 20V012000 against some 2014–2015 trucks, so run your VIN.

items.title: Load-capacity label and dealer-installed accessory campaigns
items.summary: Mostly labeling campaigns (FMVSS 110 load-capacity labels) plus a Southeast Toyota campaign for incorrectly attached distributor-installed accessories such as running boards (14V828000). Run your VIN at NHTSA to see which apply.

timeline.change: 200 Series launches in the US (production from September 2007) with the 5.7 L 3UR-FE V8 and 6-speed automatic, KDSS, CRAWL control and a new, stronger frame
Model years covered by the floor-mat pedal and TPMS recalls

First facelift (released December 2011): previously optional kit made standard; Multi-Terrain Select, Multi-Terrain Monitor, Off-Road Turn Assist and Trailer Sway Control added. Unsealed 4X4 calls 2012–15 the sweet spot for many buyers, and IH8MUD owners point US shoppers to 2013–15 trucks
Diesel markets only: the late-2015 facelift adds a DPF to the 1VD-FTV V8. Unsealed 4X4 reports DPF trouble and a Toyota recall on 2015–16 diesels. US petrol trucks never had a DPF
Second facelift: 8-speed automatic, larger front brakes, 3.30:1 axle ratio in place of 3.90:1, new nose and tail lights, bigger screens
Model years covered by the Denso fuel-pump recall
Heritage Edition for the FJ40's 60th anniversary: 1,200 built for the 2020 model year, five seats, US only
Final US model year; the 300 Series is not sold in North America, and the nameplate returns on the smaller 250 for 2024

identify.intro: The US truck is simple to identify: one engine and essentially one trim. The things to check are the Heritage Edition, the facelift year, and that the KDSS works.

items.head: Engine
items.body: Every US 200 is a 5.7 L 3UR-FE V8 (URJ200). The 4.5 L 1VD-FTV twin-turbo diesel V8, the 4.6 1UR-FE, the 4.7 2UZ-FE and the 4.0 V6 were sold in other markets only.

items.head: Pre- vs post-2016
items.body: 2016-on trucks have the 8-speed automatic, a new front fascia and grille, and headlights with daytime running lamps. 2008–2015 trucks have the 6-speed.

items.head: Heritage Edition
items.body: 2020–2021 Heritage Editions are five-seat trucks; 1,200 were built for the 2020 model year. The badge is easy to copy, so check the window sticker or the dealer build sheet.

items.head: Lexus twin
items.body: The Lexus LX 570 shares the platform and recalls. Values for the two are tracked separately.

values.intro: Late, low-mileage 2021s and Heritage Editions trade at or above their original sticker. Earlier trucks are steadier, but a tidy 200 still costs real money.
values.note: Based on 17 Bring a Trailer sales, September–October 2026: $20,300 for a 306,000-mile 2008 up to $126,000 for an 8,000-mile 2021 Heritage Edition. Most 2021s sold for $95k–117k.
